description: Example prompt templates for generating Jesus-themed nursery-rhyme songs and videos with external AI models (image/video/music). Use these with tools such as text-to-image, text-to-video or text-to-music models. The bundled procedural renderer does not require these, but they show how to extend the project with 'best available' AI tools/APIs.

style_guides.visual: Cocomelon-inspired 3D cartoon, soft rounded shapes, big friendly eyes, pastel colours, sunny outdoor scenes, gentle bounce animation, wholesome and safe for toddlers, 16:9.
style_guides.music: Sweet children's nursery-rhyme, simple singable melody, xylophone/glockenspiel/ukulele, soft child-like vocals, warm and comforting.

songs.title: Jesus Loves Me
songs.image_prompt: A fluffy smiling baby lamb on a green hill, small wooden cross behind, sunny sky with fluffy clouds, Cocomelon 3D style, pastel colours, 16:9.
songs.video_prompt: The baby lamb gently bounces and sways to a soft nursery melody while sunbeams shine, toddlers wave from the meadow.
songs.music_prompt: Gentle 96 bpm lullaby-pop version of 'Jesus Loves Me', ukulele and xylophone, sweet child vocals.
songs.lyrics_seed: Jesus loves me, this I know, for the Bible tells me so.

songs.title: Jesus Is My Friend
songs.image_prompt: A cute round white dove with rosy cheeks over a flower meadow, rainbow, Cocomelon 3D style, 16:9.
songs.video_prompt: The dove glides and loops over flowers while children clap; rainbow shimmers.
songs.music_prompt: Upbeat 108 bpm toddler pop, claps and glockenspiel, joyful kids choir.
songs.lyrics_seed: Jesus is my friend today, He walks with me every day.

songs.title: This Little Light of Mine
songs.image_prompt: A glowing smiling yellow star in a twilight sky with golden sparkles, children holding candles below, Cocomelon 3D style, 16:9.
songs.video_prompt: The star twinkles and bounces, sparkles trail behind, candlelight glows warmly.
songs.music_prompt: Joyful 100 bpm gospel kids song, hand claps and tambourine, call-and-response choir.
songs.lyrics_seed: This little light of mine, I'm gonna let it shine.

songs.title: He's Got the Whole World
songs.theme: God cares for the whole world
songs.image_prompt: Two gentle hands cupping a smiling cartoon Earth, soft clouds and stars, Cocomelon 3D style, warm colours, 16:9.
songs.video_prompt: The little Earth spins slowly and giggles inside glowing hands while stars twinkle.
songs.music_prompt: Warm 92 bpm sing-along, acoustic guitar and soft bells, comforting kids choir.
songs.lyrics_seed: He's got the whole world in His hands.

songs.title: Praise Him All Day
songs.image_prompt: A happy baby lamb jumping among balloons and confetti in a sunny field, Cocomelon 3D style, party vibe, 16:9.
songs.video_prompt: The lamb jumps, claps and spins as confetti falls and balloons float up.
songs.music_prompt: Energetic 120 bpm praise song, drums, claps, bright brass, excited kids choir.
songs.lyrics_seed: Clap your hands and praise His name!
